name: Jobber
description: Jobber is field-service management software for home-service businesses — landscaping, plumbing, HVAC, cleaning, and similar trades — covering quoting, job scheduling and dispatching, invoicing, payments, and client communication, from solo contractors up to multi-location teams.
best_for: Solo contractors and small-to-mid field-service teams (up to roughly 15+ employees) who want transparent published pricing and direct QuickBooks/Xero integration.
features: Integrations with QuickBooks Online, Xero, and Zapier

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Annual billing; range reflects plan variations.

tiers.name: Grow
tiers.notes: Marked "Most Popular" on the official pricing page.

pros: Direct, native integration with QuickBooks Online and Xero — a real advantage for buyers already using either
Published, transparent pricing across all four tiers
cons: Add-ons (Marketing Suite, Receptionist, Pipeline) are billed separately from the core subscription
Higher tiers (Connect and above) get expensive quickly relative to Core
Less enterprise-scale dispatch/reporting depth than ServiceTitan for very large operations

faq.question: Does Jobber integrate with QuickBooks or Xero?
faq.answer: Yes — Jobber has direct, native integrations with both QuickBooks Online and Xero, alongside Zapier for broader automation.

faq.question: How much does Jobber cost?
faq.answer: Jobber's published annual-billing tiers start at $21-29/month for Core and range up to $280-399/month for Plus, with add-ons like a Marketing Suite ($99/mo) billed separately.

alternatives.name: Housecall Pro
alternatives.description: Field service management software for residential home service contractors.
alternatives.best_for: Residential trade contractors wanting dispatching, online booking, and consumer financing

alternatives.name: ServiceTitan
alternatives.description: Enterprise software platform for residential and commercial trade businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Large multi-truck contractors and enterprise service businesses
